WIKIS_NOT_ENABLED: Wikis are switched off for this initiative
WIKI_PAGE_NOT_FOUND: That page is not in this wiki
WIKI_PAGE_PARENT_ITSELF: A page cannot be filed under itself
WIKI_PAGE_PARENT_DESCENDANT: A page cannot be filed under one of its own sub-pages
WIKI_HOME_NOT_IN_WIKI: The home page has to be one of this wiki's own pages
WIKI_TEMPLATE_NOT_IN_WIKI: The template has to be one of this wiki’s own pages
WIKI_LIVE_SESSION_OWNS_CONTENT: This page is being edited live. Reconnect to the editing session to save your changes.
WIKI_CONTENT_CHANGED: This page has changed since you opened it. Reload it to see the latest version, then make your change again.
AUTH_PROVIDER_RULE_NOT_FOUND: That rule is not one of yours
AUTH_PROVIDER_RULE_PROVIDER_NOT_CONNECTE: Connect that provider to your community before saying what its groups mean
AUTH_PROVIDER_PLACEMENT_NOT_ACCEPTED: That community hasn't accepted this provider's placement rules.
AUTH_PROVIDER_RULE_NEEDS_A_MATCH: A rule needs a group, a directory, or both.
AUTH_PROVIDER_RULE_SCOPE_HALF_SET: A directory needs both a claim and a value.
PASSWORD_IS_LAST_METHOD: Your password is the only way into this account. Add a passkey first.
PASSKEY_IS_LAST_METHOD: This passkey is the only way into this account. Set a password or add another passkey first.
PASSWORD_NOT_HELD: This account doesn't have a password.
PLATFORM_AUTH_FACTOR_REQUIRED: This server requires a second factor. Set one up, or enter a code, to carry on.
SETTINGS_LOGIN_METHODS_FACTOR_REQUIRED: This server still requires a second factor. Lift that requirement first.
LEGAL_NOT_CONFIGURED: This deployment has no terms of its own.
LEGAL_PORTAL_UNAVAILABLE: The terms and privacy policy can't be reached right now. Please try again in a moment.
ACCESS_GRANT_PASSKEY_INVALID: That passkey did not answer. Try again, or use your authenticator code.
SETTINGS_LOGIN_METHODS_NO_EMAIL: Set up email sending first — the code has no way to reach anybody.
EMAIL_OTP_INVALID: That code didn't work, or it has expired. Ask for a new one.
EMAIL_OTP_CANNOT_SEND: This server can't send email, so it can't send a code.
EMAIL_OTP_NO_PROVED_ADDRESS: Your account has no confirmed email address to send a code to.
COMMUNITY_NOT_DELETED: That community has not been deleted, so there is nothing to restore.
COMMUNITY_RESTORE_STATUS_INVALID: Choose the state the community comes back in.
COMMUNITY_RESTORE_SEAT_REQUIRED: Choose who will run the community before restoring it.
COMMUNITY_STATUS_NOT_SETTABLE: A community is deleted from its own settings, not from here.
COMMUNITY_PLAN_SET_BY_BILLING: Billing sets this community's limits and features. Change them in billing.
COMMUNITY_STATUS_SET_BY_BILLING: Billing sets this community's status. You can suspend it, or lift a suspension back to the status billing last set.
COMMUNITY_RESTORE_STATUS_SET_BY_BILLING: Billing sets this community's status. Restore it at the status billing last set, or suspended.
OPERATOR_USER_NOT_DELETED: That account has not been deleted, so there is nothing to restore.
OPERATOR_NOTHING_TO_VERIFY: That account has no address waiting to be confirmed.
CONNECTION_NEEDS_NARROWING: Say which accounts on this provider are yours before turning the connection on.
SUPPORT_INTAKE_NOT_CONFIGURED: Set up support intake before offering help requests — bind the support stream to a project under Platform settings › Intake.
COMMUNITY_PLUGIN_CONNECTION_VENDOR_NOT_C: This plug-in's connection isn't set up on this server yet. Let whoever runs it know.
PLUGIN_SERVICE_UNKNOWN_VENDOR_FIELD: That value isn't one this plug-in's listing asks for.
PLUGIN_SERVICE_INVALID_VENDOR_VALUE: That value isn't valid. Check its length, and that an address starts with https:// or http://.
PLUGIN_SERVICE_VENDOR_SETUP_UNAVAILABLE: This plug-in's listing doesn't offer a setup at its vendor. Enter its values by hand.
PLUGIN_SERVICE_VENDOR_SETUP_INVALID_ORGA: That isn't an organization name GitHub uses. Use letters, numbers and hyphens, up to 39 characters.
PLUGIN_SERVICE_VENDOR_SETUP_EXPIRED: This setup has expired or was already finished. Start it again from the plug-in's settings.
PLUGIN_SERVICE_VENDOR_SETUP_FAILED: GitHub didn't hand over the new app's values. Start the setup again.
PLUGIN_CHANNEL_CONNECTION_EXPIRED: That connection has run out, and the member has to connect again.
PLUGIN_CHANNEL_CONNECTION_NO_TOKEN: That connection holds no token to give.
PLUGIN_CHANNEL_TOKEN_UNAVAILABLE: The vendor didn't give a token. Try again shortly.
DASHBOARD_VIEW_MODE_NOT_ALLOWED: Your role can't run dashboards as Initiative. Ask an initiative manager.
DASHBOARD_VIEW_MODE_EDIT_NOT_ALLOWED: This dashboard runs as its initiative, so changing its widgets needs permission to run dashboards as Initiative. Switch “Run dashboard as” to Individual to edit.
ACCESS_GRANT_MODERATE_NOT_HELD: Moderation access is for people who moderate content, and is never self-issued.
HOLD_NOT_ALLOWED: Only this community's moderators can hold content for the platform.
HOLD_ALREADY_HELD: This is already held for the platform.
HOLD_LEGAL_BASIS_REQUIRED: Choose the law this content may break.
HOLD_NOWHERE_TO_SEND: The platform isn't taking moderation cases here, so a hold can't be placed. Contact whoever runs this server.
HOLD_ALREADY_RELEASED: That hold has already been released.
HOLD_CASE_NOT_FOUND: That case isn't one the platform is working.
HOLD_COMMUNITY_GONE: This community is being deleted for good, so nothing more can be held in it.
HOLD_COVERED_BY_ANOTHER: Another hold still covers this. Release that one first, or restore this one.
MODERATION_LEGAL_BASIS_NOT_TAKEN: Only a report of something illegal names a law
MODERATION_DETAIL_REQUIRED: Say what is wrong with it
MODERATION_NO_ATTACHMENTS: Don't attach anything to a child-safety report. Say where it is instead.
MODERATION_ACT_NOT_TAKEN: That can't be done to this
MODERATION_ALREADY_REMOVED: It has already been taken down
MODERATION_NOT_REMOVED: There's nothing of this removal left to put back
MODERATION_NOT_A_REMOVAL: Only a removal can be put back
MODERATION_ACTION_NOT_FOUND: That isn't in the moderation log
MODERATION_NOBODY_TO_WARN: Nobody wrote this, so there's nobody to warn
SECURITY_NOWHERE_TO_SEND: Security reports aren't set up on this server yet. Use the address below instead.
FEEDBACK_NOWHERE_TO_SEND: Feedback isn't set up on this server yet. Use the address below instead.
APPEAL_NOT_SUSPENDED: Your account isn't suspended, so there is nothing to appeal.
APPEAL_NOWHERE_TO_SEND: Appeals aren't set up on this server yet. Use the address below instead.
DEMO_LINK_NOT_FOUND: This demo link doesn't work any more. Ask whoever sent it for a new one.
DEMO_BUSY: All demo spaces are busy. Try again in a minute.
DEMO_PITCH_NOT_FOUND: This community isn't a demo pitch.
DEMO_PITCH_ADMIN_REQUIRED: Only this pitch's admins can publish it.
DEMO_PITCH_SOURCE_INVALID: The pitch's export file can't be imported, or an editor it names has no account.
DEMO_PITCH_HELD: This pitch holds content under review, so it can't be deleted yet.
DEMO_PERSONA_TAKEN: That handle belongs to a real account.
DEMO_LINK_EXPIRY_INVALID: A demo link can't end in the past.
